remarks:
Private Hilltop Cabin Retreat on 2.9 Acres in Cuba, NY
Tucked away on a private and hidden hilltop, this 2.9-acre retreat offers peace, seclusion, and the perfect country escape. Built in 1998, the cozy 900 sq. ft. cabin welcomes you with an open-concept design and soaring ceilings. A spacious loft overlooks the main floor, providing plenty of room for multiple beds or the opportunity to create private bedroom spaces to suit your needs.
Step outside and you’ll find a campfire area ready for summer gatherings or crisp fall evenings under the stars. Surrounded by nature, yet just a short drive to the conveniences of Cuba, this property is ideal for a weekend getaway, hunting cabin, or even a year-round residence with a few updates and a little finishing touch.
If you’ve been searching for a private hideaway with character and potential, this Wolf Creek gem is waiting for you. 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Timber and GMO rights convey,  Deer Hunting, Turkey hunting , Electric, Well and Septic on site, 5.5 miles to Cuba, 8.9 mules to Olean, 5.9 miles to Hinsdale. No HOA Fee.
